description: This file defines Flask request and response wrapper classes, extending Werkzeug's Request and Response classes, with additional Flask-specific attributes and methods for handling request data, URL rules, blueprints, and response configurations.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: A Flask request class extending Werkzeug's Request, adding Flask-specific attributes and properties for URL rules, view arguments, routing exceptions, and form data handling.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A Flask response class extending Werkzeug's Response, with default MIME type and configuration for cookie size, supporting JSON and other response features.

methods.name: max_content_length
methods.description: Property to get or set the maximum content length for a request, configurable via Flask app config.

methods.name: max_form_memory_size
methods.description: Property to get or set the maximum size of non-file form data in a request.

methods.name: max_form_parts
methods.description: Property to get or set the maximum number of form fields in a multipart/form-data request.

methods.name: endpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint matched for the request URL.

methods.name: blueprint
methods.description: Returns the name of the current blueprint, if any.

methods.name: blueprints
methods.description: Returns a list of parent blueprints for the current request.

methods.name: _load_form_data
methods.description: Loads form data, with special handling in debug mode.

methods.name: on_json_loading_failed
methods.description: Handles failures when loading JSON data in the request.

methods.name: max_cookie_size
methods.description: Read-only property for maximum cookie size, configurable via Flask app config.
